Our profound sympathy goes to Past President Teddy Gordon on the loss of his wife—so well remembered by so many of us. We shall miss Mrs. Gordon at our meetings and functions; and recall with gratitude her many services to the Club in the past.

After the first World War he was one of the workers who assisted in the re-birth of the Club and its gradual growth to National honours and renown; and in this he received every assitance from Mrs Gordon.
